notes.title: NEW UPDATE MARCH 2022
notes.content:
Hello!
We are excited to announce our new update on 2030!

Several bug fixed:

- Jeep on the moon surface its no more, we are dealing with some issues, he will be back soon...

- Crosshair its fixed! now looks better

- Better performance on FPS

- NEW!: Now you can watch the bullets of your weapon with a nice FX (apply for rifles)

- some graphics tweeks

- Zombies are faster and smarter // new characters on the 3rd map!

- Sound problems fixed

/// 

NEXT UPDATE soon it will include

- NEW MAPS
- NEW CHARACTERS
- SOUND SETTINGS WORKING (we are working on that on the next update)


Hope you enjoy our last release! remember: its more fun to play with friends! Host a game and call your friends via STEAM to play it with at least 4 characters on map


THANKS FOR PLAYING OUR INDIE GAMES
LFR Games
"We make indie games"
